parameters.name: HotTtl
parameters.description:
The global retention period of hot data.

>  The value of this parameter must be at least 7 and smaller than the log retention period. Unit: days.

parameters.name: LogMetaList
parameters.description: The settings of the log analysis feature.

parameters.name: Ttl
parameters.description:
The global log retention period.

>  This parameter is supported only when the log analysis feature uses the pay-as-you-go billing method.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas reset-log-shipper --ttl 180 --hot-ttl 7 --log-meta-list Status=enabled HotTtl=7 Ttl=60 ConfigLogStore=sas-security-log --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
